_comment: gift-authority-tick-fanout/06 — shared backend<->room-server contract. Backend: tests/Feature/Gift/GiftBalanceContractTest.php asserts live output matches. Room server: copied in by ticket 10 and asserted there. Balance fields are decimal STRINGS; version is an integer that only increases per user and sits BESIDE balance, never inside it (ticket 19). ticket 19: refused_senders[] carries the same snapshot for every sender whose group was refused with 4002/5000 — never in processed[]. gift-cashback-latency 01: lucky_result_payload is the `lucky:result` sender payload (also the `sender` of an inline lucky[] entry, kind=result); tapped_at is an integer epoch-MILLISECONDS stamp of the oldest tap the result covers, minted by the room server gate and OMITTED (never null) when unknown — the room server observes tap→emit latency only when it is present. gift-cashback-latency 04: inline_lucky_batch_response is a batch response whose lucky burst settled INLINE after the money committed (GIFT_LUCKY_INLINE_DRAW_BUDGET_MS): top-level lucky_inline is true (the room server ignores lucky[] without it), each lucky[] entry's sender/room payloads are emitted verbatim as lucky:result / lucky:room-result, and processed[].balance is the POST-WIN snapshot (debit and cashback both applied, version bumped by each).
